name: My Daughter's Father
description: Follows Julieta who, during her graduation party suffers a life-threatening health crisis that forces her mother, Maca, to face secrets from the past.

videos.title: Bad News
videos.overview: Not availableJulieta's graduation party becomes a nightmare when her health takes a drastic turn. Maca makes a devastating discovery that could ruin everything.

videos.title: The Past Always Comes Back
videos.overview: As Julieta goes viral, her brothers hatch a scheme to save her life. Maca is plagued by guilt. A DNA test proves a match — and a threat to both families.

videos.title: Not One, But Two Donors
videos.overview: Yolanda and Maca clash as they each work to protect their daughters. Alejandro helps Bernardo, and Gustavo witnesses a betrayal against Ricardo.

videos.title: Love That Kills
videos.overview: The fallout of Maca's mistake creates shockwaves in the Sotomayor family. Yolanda takes her daughters' futures into her own hands, and Emilio is torn.

videos.title: Free at Last
videos.overview: As her life spirals, Julieta chases Nacho to Tulum to make a dream come true. Ricardo slips up, Bernardo toes the line and Gustavo's caught by an enemy.

videos.title: Unforgiven
videos.overview: Julieta and Nacho bond, and Victoria gets good news. Yolanda and María scheme, Maca is investigated at the hospital and Gustavo takes a big step.

videos.title: Collision Course
videos.overview: Rosa confronts Alejandro and Gustavo as Bernardo and María end up in a twisted plot. Yolanda and Maca clash in Tulum, with Victoria in the middle.

videos.title: Tulum
videos.overview: Emilio and Ricardo join forces to find Bernardo and María. Julieta's dream comes true. Victoria is destroyed online, and Bernardo comes clean.

videos.title: From Past Rains Come Present Storms
videos.overview: Emilio's past with Maca is explored, from a hopeful future to a breakup. As his father struggles with health and a fall from grace, Maca meets a singer.

videos.title: The Limits of Forgiveness
videos.overview: A past debt comes due for Carlos Díaz. Emilio has a change of heart that could change Julieta's life, as one family finds hope and another falls apart.
